scope: Monk effects in authoritative server and Web presentation; no live database changes, images, layout replacement or Unity port.

benchmark.assumptions: 474 solo in-memory fixed-level fixtures, two seeds: level 1/world 1, 10/worlds 1-2, 25/worlds 2-3, 50/worlds 3-4; all unlocked loadouts. Starter equipment, supplied gold/stocks, no purchases. Not farm-earned progression or final balance. Existing high-level DEX critical/dodge formulas remain; current monsters have basic attacks, not an NPC spellcasting system.

overlapNote: Focused server tests are included in the full server total; do not sum suites as distinct checks.
limitations: Dome silence blocks skill casting, not basic attacks or movement. Current monsters do not have their own spellcasting executor; that future executor must check Entity.canUseSkills().
Shadow Dance is three simultaneous hits per target, not summoned NPCs or pet AI.
Fixed Dome lasts six seconds, six pulses; regeneration is caster-only and requires the caster to be inside.
Step bonuses are additive percentage points; duration/regen parameters not specified in the original catalogue are initial authored values.
Existing high-level DEX critical/dodge scaling remains unchanged and is not final balance.
No real-player visual validation, deployment, commit or push in this block.
